rows.title: Price history is two captures deep, not a series
rows.issue: Weeks 1-9 had kicked off before the first observation, so their stored numbers are post-hoc and cannot define an opening, a close or closing-line value. Two captures now exist and 7 of the 78 pre-kickoff market cells moved between them, so a real opening-to-latest interval exists for those cells only. The remaining 71 pre-kickoff cells still have a single observation.
rows.resolve: A scheduled capture at T-60 before every kickoff, so every graded cell has its own interval. Policy P04 sets the schedule.

rows.title: Two clubs publish no parseable depth chart
rows.issue: 30 of 32 clubs yielded depth rows. The Packers prepend jersey numbers to names and the Texans publish the chart as an image. Both are recorded as failures rather than transcribed by eye.
rows.resolve: An authorised structured export per club, or a documented decision to accept the gap.

rows.title: No official inactive list is held
rows.issue: The captured report carries 6 game designations across 254 rows. Without inactive lists, a listed player's participation cannot be confirmed and a replacement cannot be established.
rows.resolve: Capture official inactive lists per game with a timestamp before kickoff.

rows.title: The personnel ablation cannot resolve an effect
rows.issue: The holdout interval spans zero for every λ in the published grid. This is a finding about the sample, not a claim that injuries do not matter.
rows.resolve: More pre-kickoff games and dated availability captures before re-testing.

rows.title: Team-code aliases differ between sources
rows.issue: nfl.com's 2026 standings publish AZ for Arizona; the community schedule publishes ARI. Los Angeles is LA on both. The feed maps the alias explicitly and the reconciliation would fail if it did not.
rows.resolve: Keep the explicit alias map and assert it in tests; do not normalise silently.

rows.title: Kickoff times carry no time zone
rows.issue: The schedule publishes kickoff in US Eastern but the field has no zone. The price store converts at a fixed UTC-4, which is up to 60 minutes wrong once Eastern Standard Time begins.
rows.resolve: Capture an explicit UTC kickoff, or store the observation as 'pre-kickoff by minutes' instead of a boolean.

rows.title: Two strategies already failed their kill rule
rows.issue: G10 demoted two scored rules whose Brier-skill interval sits entirely below zero. They remain on the leaderboard, labelled, with their numbers intact.
rows.resolve: Require a new registration hash before a demoted rule can return.

rows.title: No reward pool, rule set or funding source exists
rows.issue: The brief asks for a leaderboard competition with rewards for top performers. No funding source, jurisdiction or payout rule exists, so no reward is described as available.
rows.resolve: Decide jurisdiction and funding before any reward is announced.

rows.title: A club with no report section is not injury-free
rows.issue: 4 clubs had no section on the captured report. Treating that as 'no injuries' is the failure mode flagged earlier in this repository.
rows.resolve: Join each no-section club to its inactive list and its next published report.

rows.title: Correlation C02 mixes a community price with an official score
rows.issue: It is published for transparency and excluded from every official-only gate. A reader who skims the table could mistake it for an official-input correlation.
rows.resolve: Keep the source-class badges on the row and the note in the caption.

rows.title: 41 report rows could not be joined to a depth slot
rows.issue: 4 correlation families and a set of report rows have no join target: a player can be on the report without appearing on his club's published chart.
rows.resolve: Publish the unmatched count beside the joined count so the join rate is never implied as 100%.

rows.title: The site's own model trails the market it compares against
rows.issue: The ridge side model's MAE is worse than the stored market spread's on the same games. It is published as a benchmark, and no strategy above it claims otherwise.
rows.resolve: Nothing to fix; it is the honest baseline. Any future model must beat this before claiming skill.
